pages.title: Ashdown Forest
pages.description: heathland area in the county of East Sussex
pages.extract: Ashdown Forest is in East Sussex. Ashdown Forest covers 14,000 acres (5,700 hectares) of lowland heathland which has never been under the plough and so provides a unique habitat for many species of flora and fauna. The whole area is designated as an Area of Outstanding Natural Beauty (OANB).

pages.title: Belize City
pages.description: most populous city in Belize and capital of the district of Belize
pages.extract: Belize City is the largest city in Belize.  It is on a small peninsula protruding into the Caribbean Sea. It was the capital city until flooding and other damage from a hurricane in 1961 prompted the government to relocate to Belmopan, closer to the geographic centre of the country.

pages.extract: Chambéry is a beautiful town in the Rhône-Alpes region of France and the birthplace and historic capital of Savoie.

pages.title: Kanazawa
pages.description: capital city in Ishikawa Prefecture, Japan
pages.extract: Kanazawa (金沢) is a historic city in Ishikawa prefecture, Japan. For travelers who want to see one of the best-preserved major Edo-period cities in the country, it's hard to beat.

pages.title: Sperlonga
pages.description: Italian comune
pages.extract: Sperlonga is a very picturesque small city in Italy south of Rome. Its white-painted houses make it a bit reminiscent of some Greek islands. It has some of the best beaches in the area. During the Italian summer holiday, it's a popular package tourist destination and all hotels may be fully booked long ahead.

pages.title: Srirangapatna
pages.description: town
pages.extract: Srirangapatna (ಶ್ರೀರಂಗಪಟ್ಟಣ Shrīrangapaṭṭana), anglicised to Seringapatam during the British Raj, is a town in Mandya district of Karnataka, India. On an island in the Cauvery River, the town of Srirangapatna was once the fortress capital of the region controlled by Hyder Ali and his son Tipu Sultan.

pages.title: Worthington (Minnesota)
pages.description: city in and county seat of Nobles County, Minnesota, United States
pages.extract: Worthington is a city in Southern Minnesota.

pages.title: San Vicente del Caguán
pages.description: Colombian municipality of the department of Caquetá
pages.extract: San Vicente del Caguán is in Caquetá. The former FARC capital of El Caguán DMZ, it isn't a tourist attraction, but does make for a convenient stop over when en route to or from La Macarena.

pages.title: Chapecó
pages.description: municipality of Santa Catarina state, Brazil
pages.extract: Chapecó is a town in Western Santa Catarina. It is the region's main transport hub, and a major industrial, financial and educational center.

pages.title: Benson (Arizona)
pages.description: city in Cochise County, Arizona, United States
pages.extract: Benson is a historic rail town of 5,400 people (2020) in Southeast Arizona. For visitors there is little of interest in the town, but it does offer a range of options for accommodation and as such can be a good base for exploring the region.

pages.title: Chimborazo
pages.description: volcano and highest mountain in Ecuador
pages.extract: Chimborazo is an inactive volcano and the highest mountain in Ecuador at just about 6,263 m (20,548 ft). It is a popular hiking and mountain climbing location.
